label: Cinematic Orchestral Pop / Epic World Fusion

cards.mood: The piece opens with an ethereal, mystical atmosphere that quickly surges into a heroic and majestic declaration.
cards.palette: A full string section (violins, violas, cellos) serves as the harmonic backbone, present from the intro to the outro, providing sweeping legato lines in the verses and staccato rhythmic drive in the choruses.
